name: Sylvia Kilver, the Eye of the Serpent

system.concept: Tremere Acting Regent Compromised by the Followers of Set
system.title: Acting Regent, Egyptian Museum Chantry
system.biography:
Background

Sylvia Kilver, daughter of a Yale Egyptologist, was Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} in 1923 after her expertise in Egyptian antiquities and black-market dealings caught the eye of a secret @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} order devoted to serpent worship. Sent to Cairo's new museum chantry under regent Kasper von Aupfholme, she chafed under his dismissive treatment and struck out on her own, falling into a dangerous partnership with the Setite sorceress Kahina — trading mummified relics and Tremere secrets for lessons in the Setite blood magic called Akhu.

Sylvia's price has escalated steadily: from antiquities to favors to clan secrets, and finally to swallowing a living Egyptian asp at Kahina's command to advance in the secret Setite-aligned order she serves. In exchange she developed her own Thaumaturgical path, Soul of the Serpent, which she believes to be entirely her own achievement. With von Aupfholme missing in the Western Desert pursuing the Shenouda Cache, Sylvia now serves as acting regent and eagerly awaits confirmation of his permanent disappearance so she may claim the chantry outright.

Roleplaying Hints

Size up everyone you meet as a potential asset or threat, projecting effortless authority over Tremere colleagues you privately despise. Around @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set}, however, drop the mask entirely into genuine, unsettling deference.
system.notes: Sire: Ophelia (Hartford chantry). Secretly compromised by the Setite sorceress Kahina, who has informed her that Kasper von Aupfholme will not return, clearing Sylvia's path to the regency. Developed the Thaumaturgical path Soul of the Serpent (Serpentine Sense, Scaleskin, Venom Curse, Touch of Typhon, Form of the Hydra) as a direct result of her Setite corruption; see the disciplines compendium for these powers as Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) items.

prototypeToken.name: Sylvia Kilver, the Eye of the Serpent

system.description: You may double the range of your sight and hearing and sharpen your other senses to remarkable acuity, perceiving things ordinary folk cannot. A sudden sensory assault, such as a loud noise or strong odor, numbs the affected sense for the rest of the scene and stuns you for a turn unless you spend a Willpower Trait. You may also receive uncontrollable visions of past or future events.
By meeting your subject's gaze and winning a Mental Challenge, you implant a more complex command, optionally tied to a specific trigger event, to be carried out immediately or later.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 1 Basic — Eyes of the Earth

system.description:
The vampire "sees" everything that transpires within 10 miles of her attuned haven or shrine by utilizing the spirits of the grass, trees, rocks, and animals in the vicinity. No sound accompanies the visions, and unless the practitioner can read lips she cannot know what is being said. If she wishes to track a particular person for more than one night, she must relocate him again after each broken contact.

System: The vampire ingests an infusion of her own vitae mixed with soil, grass shoots, leaves, animal fur, and bird feathers. The number of successes on a Willpower roll determines the duration: 1 success grants one turn, 2 one hour, 3 one night, 4 one week, and 5 one month.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Thaumaturgy: Path of the World's Blood; must be attuned to the land (One with the Land ritual)

items.name: Thaumaturgy — 2 Intermediate — Command the Freshly Dead

system.description:
The vampire can command any ghost she can see to obey her, receiving answers to questions within the ghost's realm of awareness or sending it to deliver a message. She cannot compel a ghost to perform any task requiring a material form.

System: The vampire must first use See the Dead to locate a desired ghost, then wins a contested Willpower roll against the wraith (most ghosts have 5 Willpower). Each success scored over the wraith's own answers one question or performs one simple action.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers

vtmlarp.source: Cairo by Night, Chapter Four: Dead Among the Dead
